To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new molecular descriptor, IET, was developed and optimized and applied to the prediction of the retention indexes of alkenes and alcohols, and the estimation of different properties and biological activities of alkenes, alcohols, ketones, and aldehydes.
a semi empirical topological molecular descriptor was generated and optimized to predict chromatographic retention of diverse classes of organic compounds on different stationary phases.
the semi empirical index was optimized for the prediction the chromatographic retention on low polarity stationary phase for alkenes, branched alkanese and saturated alcohos.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a new semi empirical topological descriptor (IET) in quantitative structure property/retention relationships for a diverse set organic compounds.

the development, optimization and application of a new topological index, the semi-empirical topological index (lET), to establish quantitative structure retention chromatography relationships (QSRR) for different organic compound groups and classes.
the development and application of a new semi-empirical topological index, the IET, for the prediction of different properties of organic compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the semi empirical index (IET), generated in this study, is a new molecular descriptor that has the potential of being a powerful tool in the field of QSAR/QSPRs/QSRRs.

the semi empirical index has a good predictive quality for a large number of organic compounds and properties/activities, using simple linear correlations, through a single topological molecular descriptor.

the semi empirical index (IET), is a simple, fast and reliable molecular descriptor that can be applied to predict chromatographic retention, physical, chemical and biologic properties of organic compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a new topological molecular descriptor (IET) has been generated, optimized and successfully applied for the prediction of chromatographic retention and other physicochemical and biological properties of different organic compound classes.

the semi empirical molecular descriptor, IET, is a simple, robust, versatile and efficient tool to establish quantitative structure retention chromatography relationships (QSRR), as well as to estimate properties and biological activities of organic compounds.
the semi empirical index is a simple, fast and reliable tool to predict chromatographic retention of diverse organic compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the semi empirical index can be applied for the prediction of chromatographic retention of organic compounds, as well as different physical, chemical, biological and toxicological properties.
the IET is a simple and efficient molecular descriptor for the prediction of chromatographic retention and for the development of quantitative structure property/ activity relationships.
the semi empirical index can be used for the prediction of chromatographic retention and other physical, chemical and biologic properties for different classes of organic compounds.
